import html
from markdown.extensions.toc import slugify

# Test cases
tests = [
    ('Foo & bar', 'foo-bar'),
    ('escaped_character', 'escaped_character'),
    ('<test>', 'test'),
]

for name, expected in tests:
    result = slugify(html.unescape(name), '-')
    status = "✓" if result == expected else "✗"
    print(f"{status} {repr(name)} -> {repr(result)} (expected {repr(expected)})")
